challenge.heading: Why is it so hard to assess a wealth manager?
challenge.sub: Information hard to access, and complex to analyse.
challenge.e1.title: A vast, segmented market
challenge.e1.context: More than 80 private banks, 14 cantonal banks and nearly 1'300 independent wealth managers make up the Swiss market.
challenge.e1.answer: We identify the firms best suited to your profile and consult them through a request for proposals.
challenge.e2.title: Unclear and sometimes high pricing
challenge.e2.context: Management, custody and transaction fees, currency-exchange margins, in-house product charges, sometimes with flat minimums: so many components that make the real cost hard to pin down.
challenge.e2.answer: We reconstruct the total cost according to your profile and assets, then negotiate the most suitable terms.
challenge.e3.title: Investment skills that are hard to compare
challenge.e3.context: Performance depends on many factors — investment universe and process, strategic allocation, active or passive management, security selection, currency effects… — whose respective impact is hard to isolate.
challenge.e3.answer: We analyse the risk-adjusted sources of performance, and assess the investment team and process.
challenge.e4.title: Service quality that is rarely measured
challenge.e4.context: Beyond financial criteria alone, other aspects matter just as much: the team's availability and stability, quality of advice, access to specialists, credit solutions, e-banking functionality, clarity of reporting.
challenge.e4.answer: We compare each institution's ability to sustain, over time, the services that truly matter to you.
challenge.conclusion: We give you access to the market and apply a rigorous method to compare offers on a like-for-like basis, then track results over time.

expertise_page.hero.title: When life changes, banking must too.
expertise_page.hero.sub: Our work is most impactful at life inflection points — when the stakes are high and an independent voice is essential.
expertise_page.uc1.title: Divorce & Asset Separation
expertise_page.uc1.body: When shared accounts and joint mandates must be untangled, we help define which institution serves each party's future needs — and negotiate the transition with full confidentiality.
expertise_page.uc2.title: Inheritance & Estate Transition
expertise_page.uc2.body: Inheriting a banking relationship is not the same as choosing one. We audit the existing setup, assess suitability for the heir's profile, and manage the transition with minimal disruption.
expertise_page.uc3.title: Widowhood — Banking Continuity
expertise_page.uc3.body: The surviving spouse often inherits banking arrangements they never chose and may not understand. We provide clarity, independence, and a structured review at a time when simplicity matters most.
expertise_page.uc4.title: Business Sale — Private Banking Setup
expertise_page.uc4.body: A significant liquidity event demands a private banking setup that reflects new realities. We run a full market process to identify the right partners for significant, newly liquid assets.
expertise_page.uc5.title: Corporate Treasury — Partner Selection
expertise_page.uc5.body: Family offices and SMEs holding idle treasury need banking partners optimised for yield, security and flexibility. We identify and negotiate with suitable institutions.
expertise_page.uc6.title: Expatriation — New Banking Setup
expertise_page.uc6.body: Relocating internationally means rethinking every banking relationship. We help new arrivals in Switzerland — and Swiss residents moving abroad — build a banking structure that fits their new reality.
expertise_page.cta.text: Not sure if your situation fits?
expertise_page.cta.sub: Every engagement begins with a no-commitment conversation. We will tell you honestly whether we can add value — and what a structured review would involve.

team_page.hero.title: Independent by design.
team_page.name: Gaylord Perruchon
team_page.bio: Gaylord Perruchon brings nearly 20 years of institutional asset-management experience on behalf of investment funds. A specialist in performance and risk analysis of institutional portfolios, he is a Chartered Alternative Investment Analyst (CAIA Charterholder) and has implemented GIPS-compliant performance-measurement standards. He has advised both asset-management firms and pension funds through competitive tenders and manager-research processes.
team_page.bio2: He founded IM Wealth Select® to bring this rigour to private clients. Where an individual too often relies on a firm's reputation or a personal rapport with their banker, he applies the demanding methods of large institutional investors: a forensic reading of fee structures, in-depth due diligence, and an uncompromising assessment of net performance — after all costs, adjusted for risk.
team_page.bio3: Because a manager's true worth is measured not by its promises, but by what actually remains in the portfolio once the bill is paid and the risks are under control.
team_page.zero.title: No retrocessions. Ever.
team_page.zero.body: We receive no commissions, retrocessions or benefits from any bank or manager we evaluate. Our only source of revenue is your fee.
